text:
This solution, Climate Relocation of Communities Program (CROC), 
Climate Relocation of Communities Trust Fund (CROC Trust Fund; CROCTF) addresses natural catastrophe in Republic of Fiji between Government of Fiji, Climate Change Division, Office of the Prime Minister, UNOPS/Platform on Disaster Displacement, Government of Norway, and Commonwealth National Climate Finance Advisors network. The program was implemented in 2019 and focuses on collaboration and regulation.
